fokukac_01.name: The Chief Worm
fokukac_01.description: The mini statue of the Chief Worm, the iconic companion of the Great Ho-ho-ho Angler. It is Mihály Kolodko's very first public mini statue in Budapest, created by the artist in memory of his favorite childhood Hungarian cartoon series (created by István Csukás and Ferenc Sajdik). The original version of the statue stands on the banks of the Uzh River in Uzhhorod.
fokukac_01.funFact: One of the most beloved statues among Budapest residents: on cold winter days, passers-by and fans regularly put small crocheted or knitted hats, scarves, and sometimes sweaters on it. It is one of the few statues that has a twin sibling in Transcarpathia.
fokukac_01.howToFind: It sits on top of the stone parapet opposite the Halász street tram stop on the Bem quay in the 2nd district. It faces the Danube and the Parliament, right at the intersection of the bicycle path and the promenade.

kockasfulu_01.name: The Checkered-Eared Rabbit
kockasfulu_01.description: The bronze mini statue of Veronika Marék's legendary cartoon character, The Checkered-Eared Rabbit. The fairytale hero watches the city from above, exactly as he did in the cartoons: using his telescope to look for children in trouble and adventures to be solved on the Pest side.
kockasfulu_01.funFact: It is a common custom among tourists and locals to pet the rabbit's ears or telescope for good luck, which is why the bronze surface has worn shiny on this part. The statue offers a wonderful panoramic view of the Chain Bridge and the Parliament.
kockasfulu_01.howToFind: In the Buda Castle Palace District, next to the upper station of the Buda Castle Funicular, it sits on top of the stone railing in front of the Sándor Palace, near the Turul statue, facing the Pest side.

rubik_01.name: Rubik's Cube
rubik_01.description: It commemorates Ernő Rubik's 1974 world patent, the Magic Cube (Rubik's Cube). The mini statue is a global symbol of Hungarian creativity and engineering genius, of which more than 450 million pieces have been sold worldwide.
rubik_01.funFact: The surface of the statue is designed as if it portrays a half-solved cube currently being rotated, rolling down the stone railing of the quay's stairs. When designing it, the artist deliberately chose the side facing the Parliament.
rubik_01.howToFind: On the Bem quay, walking from Batthyány Square towards the Margaret Bridge, it lies on the stone railing of the lower quay stone staircase in line with Vám Street, exactly opposite the Parliament.

sad_tank_01.name: Sad Tank
sad_tank_01.description: The miniature tank with a drooping cannon barrel is a silent memento of the 1956 revolution and war of independence. The military machine, tamed into helplessness and sadness, draws attention to the pointlessness of war and the power of the desire for freedom.
sad_tank_01.funFact: Originally, the famous inscription of the revolution 'Russians go home!' was written on its side. The first statue was stolen, so Kolodko recast it with reinforced mounting and put it back. An interesting feature of the statue is that the artist's signature can be found on it in tiny letters.
sad_tank_01.howToFind: On the Bem quay, north of the Batthyány Square tram stop, in the immediate vicinity of the large white memorial stone of the former Kossuth Bridge, on top of the stone parapet.

mekk_elek_01.name: Mekk Elek
mekk_elek_01.description: The bungling handyman of József Romhányi and József Nepp's classic puppet series, Mekk Elek (Master Mekk). The statue holds a street sign reading 'Moszkva tér' in its hand, thus commemorating the iconic former name of Széll Kálmán Square.
mekk_elek_01.funFact: The Moszkva tér sign has been broken off or damaged from the statue's hand several times, but the artist replaced it every time. In winter, local residents often give him a small knitted scarf.
mekk_elek_01.howToFind: He sits at the bottom of the pedestrian stone stairs next to the escalators leading from Széll Kálmán Square towards Várfok Street (bus stops), at the base of the stone wall.

kermit_01.name: Kermit the Frog
kermit_01.description: The bronze mini statue of the green frog from The Muppet Show, Kermit. The fairytale hero sits on the stone base of the fence as if cheerfully observing the square's wildlife and the people sitting on the cafe terrace.
kermit_01.funFact: Kermit was deliberately placed close to the trees and grass, referring to the frog's natural habitat. In cold winter months, he often receives tiny, hand-knitted scarves or hats from visitors.
kermit_01.howToFind: He sits on the stone base of the low metal fence surrounding the grassy area in the middle of Szabadság Square in the 5th district, near the park cafe's terrace.

susu_01.name: Süsü, the Dragon
susu_01.description: The mini statue of István Csukás's legendary one-headed dragon, Süsü. The figure faithfully evokes the classic puppet show of the Hungarian Television, which defined the childhood of generations.
susu_01.funFact: The first Süsü mini statue was stolen from its place by unknown persons, but Mihály Kolodko recast it with reinforced mounting and put it back. The choice of location is symbolic because the Exchange Palace standing on Szabadság Square was the headquarters of the Hungarian Television for decades.
susu_01.howToFind: In Szabadság Square in the 5th district, he stands on the left stone railing of the main staircase of the former MTV headquarters (Exchange Palace), facing the center of the square.

diver_01.name: The Diver and the Key
diver_01.location: Corner of Osvát Street and Dohány Street
diver_01.description: The statue immortalizes Ferenc Molnár's famous coffeehouse legend. According to the story, when the New York Café opened in 1894, the writer threw the key to the entrance into the Danube so that the café could never close again. The figure in the old diving suit has now brought this key up from the bottom of the water.
diver_01.funFact: The sculptor intentionally designed the key to be almost the same size as the diver figure itself. Remembering the legend, in 2014, on the café's 120th anniversary, the current management also threw a key into the Danube.
diver_01.howToFind: Behind the New York Palace in the 7th district, at the corner of Osvát Street and Dohány Street, on the concrete base of a red stone/metal fire hydrant, close to the ground.

dracula_01.name: Dracula Reading (Bela Lugosi)
dracula_01.description: A mini statue of Hollywood Hungarian actor Bela Lugosi's legendary Dracula figure, reading a book peacefully with his head lowered. The Gothic-style park environment provides a perfect background for conjuring up the famous vampire figure.
dracula_01.funFact: The placement of the statue is not accidental: since 2003, a bust of Bela Lugosi (creation of Hartmut Zech) placed during the night can also be found in the wall of Vajdahunyad Castle. The artist's signature can be found on the back of Kolodko's Dracula's cape.
dracula_01.howToFind: In the City Park, on the lake side of Vajdahunyad Castle, in the wall recess behind the Hunyadi statue, he sits on a stone ledge above eye level.

noah_ark_01.name: Noah's Ark
noah_ark_01.description: A miniature bronze replica of Noah's Ark. The artwork is a symbol of biblical salvation and the protection of wildlife, which fits perfectly into the university environment.
noah_ark_01.funFact: Looking through the tiny windows and openings of the ark, tiny animal figures in pairs can be seen inside. In sunny weather, when the light falls into the inside of the ark at the right angle, a colorful light reflection (rainbow effect) appears inside the statue.
noah_ark_01.howToFind: In Bethlen Gábor Square in the 7th district, on the side facing the University of Veterinary Medicine, it rests on the edge of a low stone ledge and decorative pool.

liszt_ferenc_01.name: Franz Liszt Waiting
liszt_ferenc_01.description: The mini statue of world-famous composer and pianist Franz Liszt. The statue combines the motif of flying and traveling with classical music: the artist is waiting sitting on a piece of luggage while folding a paper airplane.
liszt_ferenc_01.funFact: Franz Liszt was a true 'world star' of his time, who toured constantly and traveled all over Europe. With this figure, Kolodko connected 19th-century travels with modern air transport and the international airport named after him.
liszt_ferenc_01.howToFind: In front of the Terminal 2A building of Liszt Ferenc International Airport, he sits on top of a round stone pillar at the intersection of the bus stops and the pedestrian sidewalk.

herzl_01.name: Theodor Herzl and the Bicycle
herzl_01.description: A mini statue of writer, journalist, and visionary of the Zionist movement Theodor Herzl with a bicycle. The statue commemorates one of the most influential figures in Jewish history right next to his birthplace.
herzl_01.funFact: The design of the statue is based on a famous contemporary photo showing Theodor Herzl with a bicycle. The artist fixed the statue to the street lamppost as if the cyclist was pedaling down it.
herzl_01.howToFind: At the corner of Dohány Street and Károly Boulevard in the 7th district, it is attached to the side of a thick metal utility pole standing next to the Dohány Street Synagogue, at waist height.

szenes_hanna_01.name: Hannah Szenes
szenes_hanna_01.description: The memorial of Hungarian-Jewish poet and British paratrooper war hero Hannah Szenes, who died a martyr's death at the age of 23. The statue depicts the heroine in paratrooper gear, emerging from a rock face, who sacrificed her life to save Hungarian Jews.
szenes_hanna_01.funFact: This is Kolodko's statue with the saddest background story, inaugurated jointly with the 'Hosszúlépés. Járunk?' organization on March 8, 2020, International Women's Day, drawing attention to the painful absence of women in public sculpture. Hannah Szenes and lyricist Iván Szenes were cousins.
szenes_hanna_01.howToFind: In Szenes Hanna Park in the 7th district (corner of Jósika Street and Rózsa Street), it stands on a cone-like pile of stones and bricks.

seress_rezso_01.name: Rezső Seress
seress_rezso_01.description: It commemorates Rezső Seress, the composer and pianist of the world-famous 'Gloomy Sunday'. The mini statue depicts the artist sitting on a stone slab/piano shaped like a pipe.
seress_rezso_01.funFact: The statue was placed on the wall of the former Kispipa restaurant, where Seress played the piano every night for decades. Because of him, world stars such as Louis Armstrong, Spencer Tracy, Marcello Mastroianni, or John Steinbeck visited Akácfa Street.
seress_rezso_01.howToFind: At 38 Akácfa Street in the 7th district, on the brick wall of the former Kispipa restaurant, on a metal plate/stone slab shaped like a pipe, above eye level.

rejto_car_01.name: The 14-Carat Car
rejto_car_01.description: It depicts the iconic car from Jenő Rejtő's (P. Howard) 1940 pulp novel 'The 14-Carat Car'. The statue takes a sharp turn on the stone edge, symbolizing speeding in the neighborhood of the writer's former residence.
rejto_car_01.funFact: The statue is not pure bronze: its windows and headlights actually received a gilded finish, referring to the car parts made of gold in the novel. Jenő Rejtő spent his childhood in the neighboring Rejtő Jenő Street.
rejto_car_01.howToFind: In Hevesi Sándor Square in the 7th district, in front of the main entrance of the Pesti Magyar Színház (Pest Hungarian Theater), it is located on the edge of a curved stone flower bed.

mr_bean_teddy_01.name: Teddy, Mr. Bean's Bear
mr_bean_teddy_01.description: The bronze mini statue of Mr. Bean's loyal teddy bear, Teddy. The tiny bear sits high on the wall looking down at people walking on the street, conjuring up the iconic figure of British humor.
mr_bean_teddy_01.funFact: The placement of the statue is closely related to the history of the building: the British Embassy formerly operated in the property. The mini statue is a lovely memorial to British-Hungarian cultural relations.
mr_bean_teddy_01.howToFind: At 6 Harmincad Street in the 5th district, above the entrance of the former British Embassy building, it dangles its legs in a stone-framed window recess in the wall.

ratatouille_01.name: Ratatouille (The Spray-Painting Rat)
ratatouille_01.description: Ratatouille (Remy), the brilliant chef-rat from the Pixar animated film with a spray can in his hand. The figure runs up the wall to create a graffiti, combining the world of fairy tales with modern street art.
ratatouille_01.funFact: The statue is also a tribute to the iconic rat motifs of the famous, anonymous British street art artist, Banksy. With this work, Kolodko blurs the boundaries between guerrilla art and classical sculpture.
ratatouille_01.howToFind: At the Buda bridgehead of the Elizabeth Bridge (Döbrentei Square), he 'climbs' up the wall of the massive stone bridge pillar next to the pedestrian ramp, at eye level.

dreher_01.name: Anton Dreher on a Beer Barrel
dreher_01.description: A miniature portrait statue of brewer Anton Dreher, the pioneer of Hungarian brewing, looking around proudly while sitting on a wooden barrel holding a beer in his hand.
dreher_01.funFact: Anton Dreher naturalized Pilsner-type bottom-fermented brewing in Hungary, and taking advantage of the cellar system in Kőbánya, he built one of the most modern breweries in Europe. The statue pays tribute to factory traditions.
dreher_01.howToFind: In the 10th district, in the closed courtyard of the Dreher Brewery at 7-11 Jászberényi Road, it can be viewed on a wooden barrel at the Beer Museum visitor center.

soroslovak_01.name: Draught Horses
soroslovak_01.description: A bronze mini statue of a traditional draft horse pulling two beer wagons. The statue evokes the atmosphere of the streets of old Budapest and the traditional method of beer delivery.
soroslovak_01.funFact: In Kőbánya at the Dreher factory, huge Dreher horses transported beer barrels to restaurants for decades. Out of respect for the horses, the factory provided its own stables and veterinary care for them.
soroslovak_01.howToFind: On Jászberényi Road in the 10th district, it is located on the stone railing of the small limestone bridge arching in front of the main building of the Dreher Brewery.

skala_kope_01.name: Skála Kópé
skala_kope_01.description: The mini statue of Skála Kópé, the most popular advertising figure of 1980s Hungary. The round-headed, heartwarming figure is the iconic mascot of domestic retro advertising history.
skala_kope_01.funFact: Skála Kópé's famous slogan was: 'I am Skála Kópé, my advertisement is the commercial!'. The date of the statue's inauguration purposely fell on April 1st (April Fools' Day), referring to the figure's joking nature.
skala_kope_01.howToFind: In Nyugati Square in the 6th district, in the square in front of the building of the former Skála Metró department store, it stands on the stone edge of the flower bed next to the stairs.

vuk_01.name: Dangling Vuk
vuk_01.description: István Fekete's immortal little fox, Vuk, hanging helplessly and playfully on a World War II bomb protruding from a rock face.
vuk_01.funFact: The statue refers to a serious historical background: Gellért Hill was a prominent strategic point and siege location during World War II. Kolodko contrasted the kindness of the children's tale with the horrors of war.
vuk_01.howToFind: On the Szent Gellért Quay in the 1st district, on the promenade next to the Rudas Bath, looking up at the 'bomb' protruding from the rock face of Gellért Hill.

houdini_01.name: Harry Houdini
houdini_01.description: The mini statue of Budapest-born illusionist and escape artist Harry Houdini (Erik Weisz). The figure lies bound with chains and a padlock, as if he is preparing for his latest trick.
houdini_01.funFact: Houdini was born in Budapest in the 7th district in 1874 and became the greatest escape artist the world has ever seen. The placement of the statue in the inner courtyard of the Erzsébetváros Cultural Center reminds us of the artist's roots.
houdini_01.howToFind: In the inner courtyard of the K11 Art Center at 11 Király Street in the 7th district, it can be seen on the ground, at the base of a low stone wall.

columbo_mokus_01.name: Dead Squirrel
columbo_mokus_01.description: A bronze mini statue of a 'dead' squirrel surrounded by a CSI chalk outline on the ground. The statue is in direct conversation with Lieutenant Columbo standing in the background.
columbo_mokus_01.funFact: The statue is an artistic reflection on the famous installation depicting a suicidal squirrel by contemporary Italian artist Maurizio Cattelan. With a humorous twist, Kolodko placed the victim of the mysterious 'crime' behind the legs of Lieutenant Columbo (Peter Falk).
columbo_mokus_01.howToFind: Directly on the asphalt behind the life-size Columbo statue standing at the corner of Falk Miksa Street and Szent István Boulevard in the 5th district.

kotrabant_01.name: Stone Trabant
kotrabant_01.description: A Trabant 601 mini statue carved from a limestone block, equipped with a wind-up key. The artwork is an iconic symbol of the Eastern European retro lifestyle and nostalgia.
kotrabant_01.funFact: The statue was made from a single block of limestone, except for the metal wind-up key on its top, which tames the symbol of the socialist auto industry into a toy car. The choice of location rhymes with the concrete architecture left over from socialism.
kotrabant_01.howToFind: In the 3rd district, it stands on a limestone block on the edge of the parking lot and promenade under the northern ramp of the Buda bridgehead of the Margaret Bridge.

delorean_trabant_01.name: Forward to the Past (DeLorean Trabant)
delorean_trabant_01.description: A mini statue of a Trabant equipped with the gull-wing doors of the iconic DeLorean time machine from the movie 'Back to the Future'. A brilliant combination of retro and sci-fi.
delorean_trabant_01.funFact: The Keleti Railway Station is a symbol of journeys starting and arriving from Budapest and 'traveling in time'. The statue combines the Eastern European reality with the time-traveling myth of Western popular culture.
delorean_trabant_01.howToFind: In the 8th district, on the sunken underpass level in front of the main entrance of the Keleti Railway Station, it is parked on the edge of one of the stone ledges.

among_us_01.name: Stalin's Boots / Among Us
among_us_01.description: A mini statue depicting the remnant (the famous boots) of Stalin's destroyed giant statue in Budapest, from which the head of a character figure from the popular video game Among Us pops out.
among_us_01.funFact: The statue connects the history of the 1956 revolution (when the people of Pest tore down the Stalin statue) with modern digital pop culture. The essence of the 'Among Us' game is hiding and exposing the 'imposter'.
among_us_01.howToFind: In the 14th district, on Dózsa György Road, on the promenade next to the new Museum of Ethnography, on top of a low stone curb/skateboard edge.

lufikutya_01.name: Balloon Dog with Bone (Libido)
lufikutya_01.description: A satirical Hungarian version of contemporary American artist Jeff Koons' world-famous 'Balloon Dog' artwork, staring at a giant bone on the bank of the Danube.
lufikutya_01.funFact: According to Kolodko, the statue also bears the title 'Libido', referring to the fact that the bone attracts the dog like a man to a woman. The location is closely related to Cicciolina (Ilona Staller), who was Jeff Koons' wife, and her career started in the neighboring InterContinental hotel.
lufikutya_01.howToFind: In the 5th district on the Danube Promenade, on the Danube side of the InterContinental Hotel, it can be observed on a table-shaped stone bench.

balta_01.name: Axe on a Cushion
balta_01.description: A miniature axe resting on a decorative cushion. The statue is Kolodko's satirical and artistic response to the political incident when a Member of Parliament knocked the previous Ushanka statue off its place with an axe and threw it into the Danube.
balta_01.funFact: The artist was not offended by the vandalism but incorporated the reaction into the creative process: he offered the 'tool' to the destroyer. Later, in 2023, the ushanka statue 'grew flippers' and 'climbed out' of the Danube onto the quay.
balta_01.howToFind: On the northern side of Szabadság Square, it lies on one of the stone pillars of the low wrought-iron fence surrounding the Soviet military memorial.

usanka_02.name: Ushanka Returns
usanka_02.description: The little brother of the Soviet ushanka previously thrown into the Danube, which grew flippers, 'climbed out' of the river, and returned to the stairs of the Pest quay.
usanka_02.funFact: The statue is a direct continuation of the Ushanka incident in Szabadság Square. With this comic-like twist, Kolodko showed the indestructibility of art and his humorous response to public life.
usanka_02.howToFind: In the 5th district, on the Id. Antall József Quay, south of the Parliament, it stands on the bottom step of the stone stairs leading to the water in line with József Attila Street.

nincs_kompot_01.name: No Compote!
nincs_kompot_01.description: A tiny composition referring to the iconic sentence ('The Russians are already in the pantry!') and characters of the classic Hungarian comedy film 'The Corporal and Others'.
nincs_kompot_01.funFact: The statue is hidden in a deep crack in a stone retaining wall, making it the hardest of the Budapest Kolodko statues to find and photograph. The hiding itself symbolizes the hiding in the movie.
nincs_kompot_01.howToFind: On the Várkert Quay in the 1st district, in one of the vertical cracks of the stone retaining wall on the Danube bank running below the Várkert Bazár, it can be found by looking between the stones.

kutyavasar_01.name: Once Upon a Time There Was a Dog Market in Buda
kutyavasar_01.location: Corner of Batthyány Street 26 / Hattyú Street (Nevenincs Square)
kutyavasar_01.description: Six tiny bronze puppies (various Hungarian breeds, partly in a basket, partly nearby) and a King Matthias coin embedded in the ground. The sculptural group commemorates the famous Hungarian proverb and the folktale of King Matthias.
kutyavasar_01.funFact: According to the legend, King Matthias once bought the dogs of a poor man for good money in Buda, but when greedy rich people also brought dogs to sell the next day, the king chased them away, saying 'there was a dog market in Buda only once'. The coin is also related to this story.
kutyavasar_01.howToFind:
Step 1 (Area): Go to the corner of Batthyány Street and Hattyú Street in the 1st district (around Batthyány Str. 26, the so-called Nevenincs Square).

Step 2 (Focus): Look for the small square / flower beds in front of the Vízivárosi Klub (Watertown Club).

Step 3 (Exact spot): The dogs are sitting on the stone edges and in a basket, while the coin is embedded in the paving stones nearby.

romai_legios_01.name: In vino veritas (Roman Legionnaire)
romai_legios_01.description: A Roman-era soldier (legionnaire) resting carelessly against a wine amphora on the stone remains of the ancient amphitheater. The title of the statue is 'In vino veritas' (In wine there is truth).
romai_legios_01.funFact: The statue evokes the ancient Roman heritage of Aquincum. When designing it, the artist also cast a twin of it, which he placed at the Roman amphitheater in Pula, Croatia.
romai_legios_01.howToFind: In the 3rd district (Óbuda), he lies on one of the original Roman ruin stones surrounding the grassy arena of the Nagyszombat Street Roman military amphitheater.

aranka_bela_01.name: Aunt Aranka and Uncle Béla
aranka_bela_01.description: The statue commemorates the iconic and beloved florist couple of Pasaréti Square, Aunt Aranka and Uncle Béla, who sold flowers in the local booth for decades.
aranka_bela_01.funFact: This is one of the most touching Kolodko statues, which was fully realized through local community cooperation and public donations as a tribute to the couple's memory.
aranka_bela_01.howToFind: In Pasaréti Square in the 2nd district, it can be found on the edge of the low stone fence in the vicinity of the bus terminus and the former flower booth.

garfield_01.name: Garfield
garfield_01.description: The mini statue of Jim Davis's world-famous comic book hero, the lazy, lasagna-loving cat Garfield, stretching comfortably on top of the brick wall.
garfield_01.funFact: The statue was made in 2023 for the 45th birthday of Garfield's creation. The choice of location fell on the fence of the University of Veterinary Medicine because the institution is the center for healing small animals.
garfield_01.howToFind: At 4 Dembinszky Street in the 7th district, he lies on a stone pillar of the red brick fence of the University of Veterinary Medicine.

roth_miksa_01.name: Miksa Róth
roth_miksa_01.description: A miniature bust of the world-famous Hungarian stained glass painter and mosaic artist Miksa Róth. The statue is located behind a stained glass window frame, evoking the master's life's work.
roth_miksa_01.funFact: The statue has a built-in tiny lamp that illuminates the window from behind, creating exactly the effect as if sunlight was shining through Miksa Róth's colored glass, regardless of the time of day.
roth_miksa_01.howToFind: In the Miksa Róth Memorial House at 26 Nefelejcs Street in the 7th district (indoor statue), it can be viewed on contemporary furniture in the ground floor study.

lisa_simpson_02.name: Lisa Simpson (Magyar Yellow)
lisa_simpson_02.description: A mini statue of Lisa Simpson, the climate-protecting little girl from The Simpsons, chained to a yellow tram stop pole. The title of the statue is 'Magyar Yellow'.
lisa_simpson_02.funFact: The statue refers to the civil disobedience actions of environmental activists in a satirical form, while the yellow color pays tribute to the iconic tram lines of Budapest (lines 2, 4, 6).
lisa_simpson_02.howToFind: In Fővám Square in the 9th district, at the Pest bridgehead of the Liberty Bridge, it can be found at the bottom of the yellow signal post of the tram line 2 stop.

ferenc_jozsef_01.name: Franz Joseph in a Hammock
ferenc_jozsef_01.description: The mini statue of Austrian Emperor and Hungarian King Franz Joseph, resting in a comfortable hammock between the iron grates of the bridge named after him (today's Liberty Bridge).
ferenc_jozsef_01.funFact: The statue immortalizes the relaxed and free atmosphere of the 'Szabihíd' summer picnics, when the public takes possession of the closed bridge. Franz Joseph personally hammered in the last silver rivet when inaugurating the bridge in 1896.
ferenc_jozsef_01.howToFind: At the Pest bridgehead of the Liberty Bridge (from Fővám Square), he lies in a hammock stretched into one of the V-shaped support elements of the green metal structure.

fules_01.name: Headphones (Füles)
fules_01.description: A miniature headphone (studio headphone) cast in bronze, resting on the railing of the Palace of Arts (Müpa), evoking the world of music and acoustics.
fules_01.funFact: The special feature of the statue is that when it was inaugurated, it actually played music for passers-by using a built-in speaker. It is the symbol of the cultural district between Müpa and the National Theater.
fules_01.howToFind: In the 9th district, at 1 Komor Marcell Street, it 'hangs' on the metal railing of the wide staircase leading to the main entrance of Müpa from the Danube side.

szurikata_01.name: Meerkat
szurikata_01.description: A mini statue of an alert meerkat family member standing on its hind legs. The cute small animal stands guard on the fence of the children's clinic, bringing hope and smiles to recovering children.
szurikata_01.funFact: The statue was erected in cooperation with the Meerkat Foundation (an organization helping diabetic children) to draw attention to type 1 diabetes in childhood.
szurikata_01.howToFind: At 51 Bókay János Street in the 8th district, it stands on the stone base of the metal grate fence facing the street of the 1st Department of Paediatrics.

uzenet_01.name: Message (Putin and the Russian Warship)
uzenet_01.description: A miniature Russian warship standing on a stone pedestal shaped like a middle finger. The title of the statue is 'Message', which commemorates the famous act of resistance of the Ukrainian border guards on Snake Island.
uzenet_01.funFact: The statue is one of Mihály Kolodko's sharpest political statements against the war launched by Russia against Ukraine. After its erection, the statue made headlines in the international press worldwide.
uzenet_01.howToFind: In the 13th district, on the Moszkva Promenade under the Pest bridgehead of the Árpád Bridge, it is located on top of a stone column next to the asphalt road on the Danube bank.

szent_miklos_01.name: Lucky Saint Nicholas
szent_miklos_01.description: A tiny bronze statue of Lucky Saint Nicholas (the patron saint of children and travelers), resting on the window sill of the cultural center with his sack of gifts.
szent_miklos_01.funFact: A belief quickly developed among locals that touching or petting the statue of Saint Nicholas brings good luck in exams and in everyday life.
szent_miklos_01.howToFind: In the 16th district (Sashalom), at the entrance of the Corvin Cultural Center at 43/c Hunyadvár Street, on the sill of the ticket office window.

chuck_norris_01.name: Bound Chuck Norris
chuck_norris_01.description: The mini statue of action hero Chuck Norris bound in chains. The artwork humorously refers to the 2006 internet naming vote for the Megyeri Bridge, where the people of the internet voted for Chuck Norris's name for the bridge.
chuck_norris_01.funFact: Although Chuck Norris won the vote, according to the laws, a bridge could not be named after a living foreign person, so it eventually became the Megyeri Bridge. Kolodko placed the statue out on April Fools' Day (April 1st), and the action hero seems invincible even when tied up.
chuck_norris_01.howToFind: At the Pest bridgehead of the Megyeri Bridge, on the southern side of the pedestrian/bicycle path, attached to the support structure of the glass panel reading 'Pest' fixed to the railing.

holdjaro_01.name: Lunar Rover
holdjaro_01.location: Corner of Hold Street and Aulich Street
holdjaro_01.description: A mini statue of a Lunar Roving Vehicle containing a tiny astronaut dressed in a spacesuit, parked on a concrete sphere shaped like a Moon.
holdjaro_01.funFact: The statue has a double meaning: on the one hand, it is a tribute to Ferenc Pavlics, a NASA engineer of Hungarian descent who designed the wheel of the lunar rover, and on the other hand, it is a reference to Hold (Moon) Street, where Kolodko first lived when moving to Budapest.
holdjaro_01.howToFind: At the corner of Hold Street and Aulich Street in the 5th district, near the Batthyány Eternal Flame, on top of a concrete bollard/sphere used for street traffic.

micimacko_01.name: Winnie the Pooh
micimacko_01.description: A mini statue of Winnie the Pooh eating from his honey pot, sitting at Frigyes Karinthy's memorial plaque on the house wall.
micimacko_01.funFact: The placement of the statue is a tribute to language history: Milne's world-famous tale was rough-translated by Frigyes Karinthy's sister, Emília Karinthy (Mici), but Frigyes polished it into an immortal Hungarian literary masterpiece (and he got the name Micimackó from her).
micimacko_01.howToFind: On the wall of the house at 27 Damjanich Street in the 7th district, on the brick surface below the Karinthy memorial plaque, at eye level.

yoda_01.name: Master Yoda
yoda_01.description: The green mini statue of Yoda, the wise Jedi master of the Star Wars universe, sitting in meditation on the metal railing of the subway underpass.
yoda_01.funFact: Yoda is the symbol of wisdom and inner strength. In the bustling, hurried world of the subway underpass, the statue encourages travelers to stop for a moment and find inner peace.
yoda_01.howToFind: In the Szent Gellért Square (M4 metro) underpass in the 11th district, he sits on the edge of the wide metal rail between the escalators.

paddington_01.name: Paddington and Masha's Bear
paddington_01.description: Paddington Bear, the British fairytale character, riding on the back of Masha's bear (the hero of the popular Russian cartoon series) in Medve (Bear) Street.
paddington_01.funFact: The statue carries a satirical geopolitical message: Paddington Bear's original British dubbing voice was the Ukrainian president, Volodymyr Zelenskyy, during his acting career. The coexistence of the two bears reflects on the theme of war and peace.
paddington_01.howToFind: It can be viewed on the low stone ledge of the building in front of 5-7 Medve Street in the 2nd district.

leo_es_fred_01.name: Leo and Fred
leo_es_fred_01.description: Sándor Reisenbüchler and József Tóth's famous cartoon characters, Leo the lion and Fred the animal tamer, camping with a circus wagon on the bank of the Danube.
leo_es_fred_01.funFact: The statue commemorates the turn-of-the-century entertainment district of Lágymányosi Bay, the 'Little Constantinople', where circuses and nightclubs once entertained the Pest-Buda audience.
leo_es_fred_01.howToFind: At BudaPart in the 11th district (Lágymányosi Bay), on the stone wall of the promenade at the intersection of the Kopaszi Dam and the residential park.

meditalo_nyul_01.name: Meditating Rabbit (Zen Bunny)
meditalo_nyul_01.description: A mini statue of a bunny meditating in complete Zen calmness in the lotus position at the Danube stairs on the southern tip of Margaret Island.
meditalo_nyul_01.funFact: The statue is a humorous response to a previous 'rabbit attack' on Margaret Island that generated a lot of press coverage, where rabbits proliferating on the island caused alarm. The artist tamed the figure to become the island of tranquility.
meditalo_nyul_01.howToFind: At the southernmost tip of Margaret Island (at the entrance under the Margaret Bridge), where the yellow stairs lead down to the waters of the Danube, at the base of the stairs.

penzfujo_01.name: Money Blowing Man
penzfujo_01.description: A miniature man herding old pengő banknotes with a leaf blower. The statue commemorates the introduction of the forint in 1946 and the defeat of hyperinflation.
penzfujo_01.funFact: The statue standing in front of the Hungarian National Bank building refers to the world's most severe hyperinflation, when the value of the pengő halved in hours, and twenty thousand billion banknotes were swept on the street.
penzfujo_01.howToFind: In Szabadság Square in the 5th district, on the paved promenade in front of the main entrance of the Hungarian National Bank, at the intersection of the grass edge and the stone paving.

targoncas_01.name: Forklift Driver
targoncas_01.description: A miniature worker currently moving a stone block with his forklift in the vicinity of the disputed monument.
targoncas_01.funFact: The statue was placed in Szabadság Square as Kolodko's guerrilla action, as a reflection on the political and public monument debates taking place in the square and the constant transformations.
targoncas_01.howToFind: In Szabadság Square in the 5th district, at one corner of the huge stone base of the Memorial for Victims of the German Occupation, on the ground floor.

hanti_vadas_01.name: Khanty Hunter
hanti_vadas_01.description: A tiny bronze figure of a Finno-Ugric (Khanty) hunter carrying a deer on his shoulder at the foot of the bridge.
hanti_vadas_01.funFact: The statue draws attention to the Finno-Ugric roots of the Hungarian language and the ancient harmony with nature among the glass palaces and office buildings of the modern Infopark.
hanti_vadas_01.howToFind: In the 11th district, at the Buda bridgehead of the Rákóczi Bridge, on the stone parapet of the pedestrian ramp opposite the MOL Campus tower building.

pinokkio_01.name: Pinocchio
pinokkio_01.description: The bronze mini statue of Pinocchio, the fairytale hero with a nose grown due to lying, in front of the Academy of Sciences building.
pinokkio_01.funFact: In the age of fake news, the statue is a symbol of the factuality of science, the search for truth, and the spirituality of the Academy.
pinokkio_01.howToFind: In Széchenyi István Square in the 5th district, in front of the main building of the Hungarian Academy of Sciences, on the stone pillar of the low decorative fence facing the trees.

eredeti_usanka_01.name: Soviet Ushanka (Lost/Destroyed)
eredeti_usanka_01.description: The very first Soviet Ushanka mini statue, which depicted a military hat in Szabadság Square.
eredeti_usanka_01.funFact: The statue caused a political storm: in January 2020, a Member of Parliament knocked it off the stone pillar with an axe and threw it into the Danube. In its place, Kolodko later placed the 'Axe on a Cushion' statue.
eredeti_usanka_01.howToFind: It can no longer be found at the location (destroyed/lost, the Axe on a Cushion statue can be seen in its place).

piszoar_01.name: Urinal (Marcel Duchamp) (Lost/Stolen)
piszoar_01.description: A miniature bronze version of Marcel Duchamp's famous Dadaist artwork ('Fountain' / Urinal).
piszoar_01.funFact: The statue referred to the roots of contemporary fine art, but unfortunately, a few weeks after its placement, unknown persons illegally removed and stole it.
piszoar_01.howToFind: It can no longer be found at the location (it stood in the park around Vajdahunyad Castle in the City Park).

eredeti_lisa_simpson_01.name: Lisa Simpson (Original) (Lost/Stolen)
eredeti_lisa_simpson_01.description: Lisa Simpson's very first mini statue in Budapest, which stood at the tram line 2 stop.
eredeti_lisa_simpson_01.funFact: The statue was stolen from Jászai Mari Square shortly after its placement. Mihály Kolodko did not give up, but later placed the replacement of the statue in Fővám Square under the name 'Magyar Yellow'.
eredeti_lisa_simpson_01.howToFind: It can no longer be found at the location (it stood at the tram stop in Jászai Mari Square).

dron_01.name: Drone / Swedish Screw
dron_01.location: Bem Quay / Angelo Rotta Quay (near Margaret Bridge)
dron_01.description: A stylized bronze miniature drone statue with three crowns on top (referring to the coat of arms of Sweden). It reflects on modern technology and the world of military drones in a humorous way.
dron_01.funFact: The statue was previously exhibited in Vác under the name Drone/Swedish Screw. It 'landed' on the Bem Quay near Margaret Bridge in the summer of 2025.
dron_01.howToFind:
Step 1 (Area): Go to Bem Quay, towards the Buda bridgehead of Margaret Bridge (Angelo Rotta Quay).

Step 2 (Focus): Look for the stone parapet near the tram stop.

Step 3 (Exact spot): The drone 'lands' on top of the parapet.

piszkos_fred_01.name: Dirty Fred, the Captain
piszkos_fred_01.location: Széchenyi István Square (next to the Hungarian Academy of Sciences)
piszkos_fred_01.description: A bronze miniature statue of Captain Dirty Fred, the legendary novel character of Jenő Rejtő (P. Howard). With a pipe in his mouth, he sits casually on a travel trunk / sea chest on the bank of the Danube.
piszkos_fred_01.funFact: It was placed there around Christmas 2025. The choice of location is a deliberate contrast: the iconic figure of Budapest humor and pulp fiction appears at the foot of the Hungarian Academy of Sciences, which represents high culture.
piszkos_fred_01.howToFind:
Step 1 (Area): Go to Széchenyi István Square, to the building of the Hungarian Academy of Sciences.

Step 2 (Focus): Look for the Danube promenade / stone railing on the side of the Academy.

Step 3 (Exact spot): He is sitting on top of the chest next to a stone element / pillar, facing the Chain Bridge.

ii_erzsebet_01.name: Elizabeth II (Empire / Yellow Submarine)
ii_erzsebet_01.location: No longer in public space (Previously: Millenáris Park)
ii_erzsebet_01.description: British Queen Elizabeth II stands elegantly dressed, waving on top of a submarine. The artwork refers to the Beatles' song Yellow Submarine and the fact that the Queen awarded the band members in 1965.
ii_erzsebet_01.funFact: The statue was originally placed temporarily in one of the ponds of Millenáris Park during the Art Market Budapest in October 2024. As it was a guerrilla exhibition piece, it was later moved to the Pannónia House in Vác for the 'Danube Shark' exhibition.
ii_erzsebet_01.howToFind:
ATTENTION: This statue is currently not visible in public spaces!

Step 1 (Area): Originally, it was located near Building B of Millenáris Park (from Lövőház Street).

Step 2 (Focus): You had to look for the small pond next to Building B.

Step 3 (Exact spot): It stood in the middle of the pond (it was a temporary placement).

veszprem_erno_01.name: Ernő the Guard
veszprem_erno_01.description: Ernő, the Guard of the Castle symbolizes the historical past and protection in Veszprém. The statue wears the uniform of the Hungarian Royal Crown Guard, commemorating the fact that the Holy Crown and the Holy Right Hand were guarded in Veszprém for a month in 1944.
veszprem_erno_01.funFact: The statue was named after Crown Guard Commander Ernő Pajtás in a public vote. The letter 'B' on the statue's cap refers to the son of the client (the owner of A1-Sped Kft.) named Balázs.
veszprem_erno_01.howToFind: At the beginning of Vár Street in Veszprém, located at the base of the western pillar of the Heroes' Gate, standing next to the stone wall.

veszprem_odon_01.name: Ödön the Street Musician
veszprem_odon_01.description: Ödön, the street musician commemorates the present era and Veszprém's vibrant musical life. The instrumental figure sitting on his suitcase is the symbol of the Veszprém Street Music Festival and the city's UNESCO 'City of Music' title.
veszprem_odon_01.funFact: The letter 'A' on the figure's cap represents the initial of a family member named Andrea of the Veszprém entrepreneur who commissioned the statue.
veszprem_odon_01.howToFind: In downtown Veszprém, on the pedestrian section of Kossuth Lajos Street, at the street furniture / low stone wall near the Hangvilla event center.

veszprem_leonora_01.name: LeoNóra, the Girl and the Lion
veszprem_leonora_01.description: LeoNóra, the little girl sitting on a lion's back tapping on a smartphone, represents the future, courage, and the peace of childhood. The statue also refers to the childhood years of Saint Margaret of the Árpád dynasty in Veszprém.
veszprem_leonora_01.funFact: The letter 'T' on the little girl's chest is the initial of the client's third child (Tamás). The statue was placed in the immediate vicinity of the Margaret ruins.
veszprem_leonora_01.howToFind: In Veszprém, she sits on the iron-stone railing of the small bridge in Kollégium Street arching over the Séd stream.

vac_anyam_tyukja_01.name: My Mother's Hen (Morzsa Dog)
vac_anyam_tyukja_01.description: It depicts the main characters (Morzsa dog and the mother hen) of Sándor Petőfi's iconic poem 'My Mother's Hen'. Petőfi wrote the poem in his parents' home in Vác, and the statue also conjures up the poet's passion for railway travel.
vac_anyam_tyukja_01.funFact: The placement of the statue is consciously connected to the railway: it received its place in the square in front of the Vác Railway Station, linking the literary memories of Vác and Hungarian railway history (the Pest-Vác line was the first Hungarian railway line).
vac_anyam_tyukja_01.howToFind: In Vác, in the square in front of the main entrance of the Railway Station (42 Széchenyi Street), they sit on the edge of the raised stone/concrete flower bed.

vac_maria_terezia_01.name: Ecstasy of Maria Theresa
vac_maria_terezia_01.description: It immortalizes the terrified, ecstatic moment of Hungarian Queen Maria Theresa. According to the legend, during the monarch's visit to Vác in 1764, she did not dare to pass under the Triumphal Arch (Stone Gate) erected in her honor in 2 weeks, because she feared it would collapse, so she clutched her heart.
vac_maria_terezia_01.funFact: The positioning of the mini statue creates a perfect photo spot: if we look from the right angle, the original Vác Triumphal Arch is outlined perfectly in the background.
vac_maria_terezia_01.howToFind: In Vác, on the promenade of the small landscaped area next to the Stone Gate (Triumphal Arch), on top of a low metal or stone post.

vac_csuzli_01.name: Slingshot (Ferenc Sajdik)
vac_csuzli_01.description: A mini statue made in honor of Kossuth Prize-winning graphic artist and caricaturist Ferenc Sajdik, depicting a figure stretching a slingshot.
vac_csuzli_01.funFact: Ferenc Sajdik is tied to the city of Vác with a thousand threads: the permanent collection and exhibition presenting the artist's life's work is located in the Pannónia House standing in the main square.
vac_csuzli_01.howToFind: In Vác, in Március 15. Square (Main Square), on top of a carved stone pillar in front of the entrance to the Pannónia House.

vac_betoncapak_01.name: Concrete Sharks (Danube Sharks)
vac_betoncapak_01.description: An eco-friendly 'Concrete Sharks' statue group made using plastic and metal waste caught from the Danube river.
vac_betoncapak_01.funFact: The statue draws attention to environmental protection and the cleanliness of the Danube. It was created with the support of the Ignác Tragor Museum as an ecological art project.
vac_betoncapak_01.howToFind: In Vác, on the stony/watery section next to the Danube bank promenade, located close to the riverbank.

tihany_gomboc_artur_01.name: Artúr Gombóc
tihany_gomboc_artur_01.description: The chocolate-loving bird from István Csukás and Ferenc Sajdik's popular Pom Pom fairy tale, Artúr Gombóc, with a Balaton chocolate bar in his wings.
tihany_gomboc_artur_01.funFact: One of the most popular rural statues among tourists and children: visitors regularly leave real chocolates and sweets between Artúr Gombóc's claws.
tihany_gomboc_artur_01.howToFind: In Tihany, on the Pisky promenade between the Abbey and the Echo Hill, he sits on top of the basalt stone wall facing Lake Balaton.

szigliget_kempingezok_01.name: Balaton Campers
szigliget_kempingezok_01.description: A mini statue of a Volkswagen Golf camper car pulling a tiny caravan high on the castle wall.
szigliget_kempingezok_01.funFact: The statue conjures up the golden age of Balaton camping in the 70s and 80s and the life feeling of retro vacations on the rocks of the Szigliget Castle.
szigliget_kempingezok_01.howToFind: On the top level of the Szigliget Castle, it 'parks' on top of the stone wall of the Benedictine tower facing Badacsony.

hortobagy_csontvary_01.name: Tivadar Csontváry Kosztka
hortobagy_csontvary_01.description: A mini statue of painter Tivadar Csontváry Kosztka, creating with a spray can in the middle of the puszta.
hortobagy_csontvary_01.funFact: It commemorates Csontváry's famous painting 'Storm on the Hortobágy'. The statue is part of Kolodko's international Csontváry series (Munich, Mostar, Hortobágy).
hortobagy_csontvary_01.howToFind: In Hortobágy, he walks on the brick parapet/stone railing of the famous Nine-arched Bridge, facing the puszta.

esztergom_pumukli_01.name: Pumuckl
esztergom_pumukli_01.description: The mini statue of Pumuckl, the red-haired mischievous goblin, hiding in the recess of the stone wall.
esztergom_pumukli_01.funFact: The reason for the choice of location: Pumuckl's unforgettable Hungarian dubbing voice, actor Kornél Pusztaszeri, was born in the city of Esztergom.
esztergom_pumukli_01.howToFind: In Esztergom, on the Little-Danube Promenade, he sits in one of the recesses of the high stone wall of the Saint Elizabeth High School.

gyula_lo_01.name: Horse in the Pool
gyula_lo_01.description: A miniature bronze horse bathing in thermal water in the covered hall of the medicinal spa.
gyula_lo_01.funFact: The statue commemorates the former Riding Hall building of the Gyula Castle Spa, where the horses of the Almásy counts once stood, and today a medicinal pool operates in it.
gyula_lo_01.howToFind: In Gyula, in the medicinal pool of the covered Riding Hall building of the Castle Spa (can only be visited with a spa ticket).

nyirbator_sohordo_01.name: Salt Merchant (Nyírbátor)
nyirbator_sohordo_01.description: A salt merchant mini statue paying tribute to the memory of the Historical Salt Route, carrying a salt barrel on his back.
nyirbator_sohordo_01.funFact: This statue is part of a cross-border sculpture route consisting of 5 Hungarian (and 5 Transcarpathian) pieces, which marks the medieval Transylvanian salt transport route.
nyirbator_sohordo_01.howToFind: Placed on stone ledges on the downtown promenades and main squares of the given settlements (Nyírbátor, Nagykálló, Vásárosnamény, Csenger, Tiszabecs).

nagykallo_sohordo_01.name: Salt Merchant (Nagykálló)
nagykallo_sohordo_01.description: A salt merchant mini statue paying tribute to the memory of the Historical Salt Route, carrying a salt barrel on his back.
nagykallo_sohordo_01.funFact: This statue is part of a cross-border sculpture route consisting of 5 Hungarian (and 5 Transcarpathian) pieces, which marks the medieval Transylvanian salt transport route.
nagykallo_sohordo_01.howToFind: Placed on stone ledges on the downtown promenades and main squares of the given settlements (Nyírbátor, Nagykálló, Vásárosnamény, Csenger, Tiszabecs).

vasarosnameny_sohordo_01.name: Salt Merchant (Vásárosnamény)
vasarosnameny_sohordo_01.location: Vásárosnamény, Park in front of Town Hall
vasarosnameny_sohordo_01.description: A salt merchant mini statue paying tribute to the memory of the Historical Salt Route, carrying a salt barrel on his back.
vasarosnameny_sohordo_01.funFact: This statue is part of a cross-border sculpture route consisting of 5 Hungarian (and 5 Transcarpathian) pieces, which marks the medieval Transylvanian salt transport route.
vasarosnameny_sohordo_01.howToFind: Placed on stone ledges on the downtown promenades and main squares of the given settlements (Nyírbátor, Nagykálló, Vásárosnamény, Csenger, Tiszabecs).

csenger_sohordo_01.name: Salt Merchant (Csenger)
csenger_sohordo_01.description: A salt merchant mini statue paying tribute to the memory of the Historical Salt Route, carrying a salt barrel on his back.
csenger_sohordo_01.funFact: This statue is part of a cross-border sculpture route consisting of 5 Hungarian (and 5 Transcarpathian) pieces, which marks the medieval Transylvanian salt transport route.
csenger_sohordo_01.howToFind: Placed on stone ledges on the downtown promenades and main squares of the given settlements (Nyírbátor, Nagykálló, Vásárosnamény, Csenger, Tiszabecs).

tiszabecs_sohordo_01.name: Salt Merchant (Tiszabecs)
tiszabecs_sohordo_01.description: A salt merchant mini statue paying tribute to the memory of the Historical Salt Route, carrying a salt barrel on his back.
tiszabecs_sohordo_01.funFact: This statue is part of a cross-border sculpture route consisting of 5 Hungarian (and 5 Transcarpathian) pieces, which marks the medieval Transylvanian salt transport route.
tiszabecs_sohordo_01.howToFind: Placed on stone ledges on the downtown promenades and main squares of the given settlements (Nyírbátor, Nagykálló, Vásárosnamény, Csenger, Tiszabecs).

munich_csontvary_01.name: Tivadar Csontváry Kosztka
munich_csontvary_01.description: A mini statue of the painter Tivadar Csontváry Kosztka in Munich, depicting him as a graffiti artist creating art in the Bavarian capital with a spray can in his hand.
munich_csontvary_01.funFact: The statue is an exact twin of the Csontváry statue at the Nine-holed Bridge in Hortobágy. Csontváry began his art studies in Munich at Simon Hollósy's free school.
munich_csontvary_01.howToFind: Step 1: In downtown Munich, walk along Prinzregentenstraße towards the Angel of Peace (Friedensengel) monument. Step 2: Look for the stone railing of the terraced steps. Step 3: The bronze statue is located on the stone parapet at pedestrian height.

munich_pumukli_01.name: Pumuckl
munich_pumukli_01.description: A mini statue of Pumuckl, the most famous and lovable mischievous goblin of Bavarian-German television.
munich_pumukli_01.funFact: Kolodko hid the statue in Munich in 2022, paying tribute to the famous children's book and TV series (Meister Eder und sein Pumuckl) set in Munich.
munich_pumukli_01.howToFind: Step 1: In Munich, keep your eyes open along the stone walls and bridge edges around the Isar river. Step 2: Look for the tiny bronze goblin with his characteristic messy hair.

munich_oktoberfest_01.name: Oktoberfest (Ein Hoch auf das Oktoberfest!)
munich_oktoberfest_01.description: A bronze hand reaching out from the asphalt, holding a traditional Bavarian beer mug high.
munich_oktoberfest_01.funFact: The artist placed the statue at the site of the world's largest beer festival, the Theresienwiese, in 2020 (unfortunately, according to reports, it has since been vandalized or disappeared).
munich_oktoberfest_01.howToFind: Step 1: Visit the huge open space of the Theresienwiese in Munich. Step 2: Look for the statue 'reaching out' from a crack in the concrete/asphalt.

landshut_rakoczi_01.name: Francis II Rákóczi (Landshut)
landshut_rakoczi_01.description: A tiny bronze statue of Prince Francis II Rákóczi, resting comfortably next to a spring in Landshut, Bavaria.
landshut_rakoczi_01.funFact: The statue was placed next to the local Rákóczi Spring (Rákóczi-Quelle) in 2020. The spring is linked to Hungarian history and the Kuruc soldiers/Prince Rákóczi who once passed through here.
landshut_rakoczi_01.howToFind: Step 1: In the city of Landshut, find the street 'Am Schallermoos'. Step 2: Walk to the water of the Rákóczi Spring. Step 3: The statue is sitting on the stones around the water spout.

nuremberg_ajtosi_01.name: Adalbert Ajtósi (Albrecht Dürer the Elder)
nuremberg_ajtosi_01.description: A miniature monument to the goldsmith father of the famous German painter Albrecht Dürer (Adalbert Ajtósi).
nuremberg_ajtosi_01.funFact: Kolodko created the statue in 2021 for the 550th anniversary of Adalbert Ajtósi's birth. The name is no coincidence: the Dürer family originally hailed from the settlement of Ajtós (German 'Türer' -> Dürer) near Gyula.
nuremberg_ajtosi_01.howToFind: Step 1: Visit the historical center of Nuremberg, specifically the Tucher Mansion (Museum Tucherschloss). Step 2: Enter the inner courtyard of the museum. Step 3: The statue welcomes you on one of the stone surfaces in the castle courtyard.

prague_rakoczi_01.name: Francis II Rákóczi
prague_rakoczi_01.description: A mini statue depicting the young Francis II Rákóczi.
prague_rakoczi_01.funFact: It commemorates the prince's student years in Prague (1691–1692). The small statue was unveiled with the help of the Liszt Institute in Prague, complementing the already existing Rákóczi memorial plaque there.
prague_rakoczi_01.howToFind: Step 1: In Prague, head to the Lesser Town Square (Malostranské náměstí). Step 2: Look for the building of the former Jesuit college. Step 3: The tiny bronze figure is located right next to the wall-mounted Rákóczi memorial plaque, on the wall or its ledge.

vienna_alex_delarge_01.name: Alex DeLarge (A Clockwork Orange)
vienna_alex_delarge_01.description: A mini statue of the sociopathic main character (Alex, played by Malcolm McDowell) of the cult Stanley Kubrick film 'A Clockwork Orange', complete with cane and bowler hat.
vienna_alex_delarge_01.funFact: In the film and book, Alex was a fanatical admirer of Beethoven's music (calling him 'lovely, lovely Ludwig van'). With brilliant genius, Kolodko therefore placed him exactly on the pedestal of the Beethoven monument in Vienna in 2023.
vienna_alex_delarge_01.howToFind: Step 1: Walk to Beethovenplatz near the Stadtpark in Vienna. Step 2: Stop at the gigantic 19th-century Beethoven monument towering in the middle of the square. Step 3: You will find the statue on the left stone blocking the stairs in front of the main monument.

venice_selfie_01.name: Selfie in Venice
venice_selfie_01.description: The statue depicts the winged lion of St. Mark, or a typical tourist with flippers, taking a selfie over the canal with a selfie stick.
venice_selfie_01.funFact: The artwork holds a funhouse mirror up to modern, superficial mass tourism. Unfortunately, according to reports, the artwork disappeared from its original location in 2024, so it likely fell victim to a thief.
venice_selfie_01.howToFind: Step 1: Visit the Santa Maria della Pietà church. Step 2: Step onto the waterfront part of the port in front of the church. Step 3: The statue originally photographed itself towards the sea here on the stones, but today (since 2024) you will only find its former spot.

pula_legionarius_01.name: In vino veritas (Roman Legionary)
pula_legionarius_01.description: A mini statue of a Roman legionary soldier, casually lounging with an amphora, intoxicated by wine, at the foot of the ancient amphitheater.
pula_legionarius_01.funFact: The statue is an exact replica of the Roman soldier statue in Óbuda, Budapest. The two artworks form a kind of invisible historical bridge between the two former Roman provinces.
pula_legionarius_01.howToFind: Step 1: Visit the famous Roman amphitheater (Pula Arena) in the center of Pula. Step 2: Walk along the outer ruined stone walls of the building. Step 3: The mini statue lies among the stones of the walls in the grass.

rijeka_piszkos_fred_01.name: Knife in the Sailor (Dirty Fred, the Captain)
rijeka_piszkos_fred_01.description: An artwork capturing the very first scene of Jenő Rejtő's novel. A sailor is painted on the wall (graffiti), with a real tiny bronze knife sticking out of his back.
rijeka_piszkos_fred_01.funFact: The statue refers to the cult opening line of Hungarian pulp fiction ('– Sir! I've come for my knife! / – Where did you leave it? / – In some sailor.'). This is how Kolodko smuggled Budapest humor to the seaside.
rijeka_piszkos_fred_01.howToFind: Step 1: Walk around the port of Rijeka (Rijeka Luka) or the downtown streets near the sea. Step 2: Look for a wall section with a simple black-line drawing of a sailor. Step 3: The pearl-handled dagger stuck in his back is a tangible, physical mini statue.

rijeka_carpathia_01.name: Carpathia Steamship
rijeka_carpathia_01.description: A mini statue commemorating the lifebuoy of the RMS Carpathia ocean liner, which rescued the survivors of the Titanic.
rijeka_carpathia_01.funFact: The Carpathia set sail from Rijeka (Fiume) with a Hungarian crew before the fateful night, and Europe's only original Titanic lifebuoy is exhibited in the Maritime and History Museum in Rijeka. This tiny artwork, installed in 2024, serves as a memorial to this.
rijeka_carpathia_01.howToFind: Step 1: Go to the coastal port promenade of Rijeka. Step 2: Pay attention to the joints and piers of the thick stone walls along the coast. Step 3: The bronze cast lifebuoy is stylishly anchored on the stones.

lendva_lecso_01.name: Cauldron (Ratatouille)
lendva_lecso_01.description: The figure of Remy, the well-known gastro-rat from the Pixar movie, holding a wooden spoon while working at a graffiti that reads 'Bogrács' (Cauldron).
lendva_lecso_01.funFact: Lendava is known for its famous Bogrács Festival (Cauldron Festival), which is why Kolodko created the twin of the Ratatouille statue in Budapest here in 2022 to honor the local culinary arts.
lendva_lecso_01.howToFind: Step 1: Visit the downtown area of Lendava, around the local Gallery-Museum and theater. Step 2: Look for a modern retaining wall with the word 'Bogrács' sprayed on it. Step 3: The little bronze rat sits on the ledge right in front of the inscription.

mostar_csontvary_01.name: Tivadar Csontváry Kosztka (Mostar)
mostar_csontvary_01.description: A mini statue of Csontváry, depicting the painting genius summoning his spirit in the Balkan city with a spray can.
mostar_csontvary_01.funFact: Csontváry painted his iconic masterpiece 'Roman Bridge in Mostar' here in 1903. Kolodko installed the statue in the summer of 2023 for the 170th anniversary of the painter's birth.
mostar_csontvary_01.howToFind: Step 1: Visit Mostar's iconic landmark, the Old Bridge (Stari Most). Step 2: Go down to the bank of the Neretva river downstream (south) of the bridge, on the side closer to the Croatian shore. Step 3: You will find the statue on a waterfront rock about a hundred meters from the Old Bridge.

stockholm_nobel_01.name: Alfred Nobel
stockholm_nobel_01.description: A tiny bronze statue depicting the portrait of Alfred Nobel, the inventor of dynamite and founder of the world-famous scientific prize.
stockholm_nobel_01.funFact: Hungary boasts one of the highest numbers of Nobel laureates relative to its population size, so the statue was created as a symbol of Swedish-Hungarian cultural and scientific respect.
stockholm_nobel_01.howToFind: Step 1: Head to Stockholm's diplomatic district called Östermalm, specifically the building at Dag Hammarskjölds väg 10. Step 2: Look for the wrought-iron fence of the Hungarian Embassy. Step 3: The statue is located directly on the street-facing fence.

stockholm_karlsson_01.name: Karlsson-on-the-Roof (MiniKarlsson)
stockholm_karlsson_01.description: Astrid Lindgren's fairytale hero, Karlsson, who flies with a propeller on his back, presented with a modern twist: holding a drone controller and wearing VR goggles.
stockholm_karlsson_01.funFact: Kolodko brought the traditional Swedish character into the 21st century and placed the statue at one of Stockholm's most beautiful viewpoints overlooking the sea in 2023.
stockholm_karlsson_01.howToFind: Step 1: Go up to the Södermalm district in Stockholm, to Fjällgatan street. Step 2: Walk around number 44 Fjällgatan, to the viewpoint terrace. Step 3: The figure sits on the thick stone ledge.

istanbul_barabas_01.name: Barabás (The Paul Street Boys)
istanbul_barabas_01.description: A bronze statue depicting one of the characters from Ferenc Molnár's novel, Barabás, sitting right on the huge stone-carved seal of the Putty Club.
istanbul_barabas_01.funFact: One of the newest international works: unveiled in January 2026 during the Hungarian-Turkish Cultural Season. The novel is required reading in Turkey, so the locals also welcomed it with bursting joy.
istanbul_barabas_01.howToFind: Step 1: Near Istanbul's bustling pedestrian street, Istiklal Caddesi (Beyoğlu district), look for the local Liszt Institute. Step 2: The statue sits on a wall section / pillar above the information board with a QR code placed on the street front.

seoul_liszt_01.name: Franz Liszt (Seoul)
seoul_liszt_01.description: A mini statue of composer Franz Liszt in Seoul, waiting while sitting on a suitcase.
seoul_liszt_01.funFact: Hungarian classical music has a huge cult following in South Korea. This statue is an exact replica of the Liszt statue at the Budapest airport (number 4 in the series), with which Kolodko gifted the Asian audience as well.
seoul_liszt_01.howToFind: Step 1: Visit the local Hungarian Cultural Center (Liszt Institute) in downtown Seoul. Step 2: The statue rests on a stone bench/pedestal next to the entrance of the institute.

princeton_einstein_01.name: Albert Einstein
princeton_einstein_01.description: A mini statue of physicist Albert Einstein in Princeton, sitting on a stone bench pondering the mysteries of the universe.
princeton_einstein_01.funFact: This is the artist's first public mini statue in America. Einstein spent the last more than twenty years of his life at Princeton University, and Kolodko brought him this memorial in 2019.
princeton_einstein_01.howToFind: Step 1: Travel to the Princeton University campus in New Jersey. Step 2: Visit the walkways of Marquand Park opposite the former Einstein house. Step 3: The statue is sitting on one of the resting stone benches/low pedestals.
